text:
Mona: Late-shift async check-in — quick notes
Mona: What I did: rotated canary to v2 (50%->0%), applied hotfix to regen worker (reduces memory churn), backfilled the short-lived feature-flag state. Verified core health pages.
Mona: Blockers: small spike (~3%) of 503s from eu-west1 routing when sequence lengths > 1024; autoscaler showed some jitter during the spike. Haven't reproduced locally.
Alex: Copy. Can you paste the short log around the 503s? Also link to the latency dashboard?
Mona: Logs (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-17T01:12:34Z] regen-worker-3 ERROR: KV cache miss flood, backpressure engaged
[2026-03-17T01:12:35Z] router-eu-2 WARN: upstream timeout 504 for /v1/generate (seq=1150)
[2026-03-17T01:12:36Z] autoscaler INFO: scale down candidate aborted (inflight > 0)
```
Mona: Dashboard: https://console.redwood/ops/dashboards/regen-latency?range=15m
Mona: Temp mitigation I'm about to run: flip routing fallback for eu-west to us-central for 10m, enable request-level KV-prefetch on regen path.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2026-03-17T01:15:00Z: v2 -> v1 fallback configured by Mona — status: SUCCESS :white_check_mark:
Jun: Saw the tail latency bump correlated with some outlier model shards. Rerouting to us-central sounds good. I can patch the routing policy to add a short-circuit for sequences > 1000 tokens. Command I ran in staging:
```
redwood route update --region eu-west1 --fallback us-central --condition "seq_len>1000" --ttl 600
```
Mona: Doing the reroute now, will monitor for 20m. Who's taking next shift?
Tara: I can pick up at 02:00 UTC and watch autoscaler + regen queue. I'll open a follow-up ticket and include playbook steps. Ticket: https://issues.redwood/INC-8271
Alex: Quick FYI — pinging @Jun on PR #4321 (autoscaler debounce tweak). If we merge, it should reduce the jitter during brief scale events.
Jun: Noted, I'll take a look first thing. I also added a temporary alert: regen.queue.depth > 200 for 2m -> page oncall.
Mona: Action items before handoff: 1) Keep reroute for 20m and verify 503s drop; 2) Watch autoscaler logs; 3) Tara to open follow-up with timeline; 4) Alex/Jon review PR #4321 for debounce.
Mona: Closing handoff — thanks team, I'll post an update in 20m. :thumbsup:
